instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for MatchHarbor Contribution Review: The objective is to review grant match-contribution records and add verified eligible contributions to the recorded match total. Grant Recipient Officers submit contribution records with source and description information and receive outcomes. Evidence Clerks record supporting evidence and contribution types. Valuation Reviewers record eligibility and recognized amounts. Program Finance Officers record verification outcomes and return reasons. Grant Ledger Clerks add eligible verified contributions to the match total and send outcomes. Grant-payment disbursement and budget amendment are outside the project. The contribution types, eligibility criteria, recognized-amount criteria, and delivery channel remain undefined.

output.business_objective: Review grant match-contribution records and add verified eligible contributions to the recorded match total.
